nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender in the constructor and updated by transferOwnership.
ERC20.totalSupply: total token supply declared in the ERC20 interface used by TokenTimelock.
TokenTimelock.token: ERC20 token contract held by the timelock.
TokenTimelock.beneficiary: address that receives the released tokens.
TokenTimelock.releaseTime: timestamp after which tokens can be released.
Ownable() constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
Ownable.transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner function that reassigns the owner state variable.
Ownable.onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner).
TokenTimelock(ERC20,address) constructor: stores token and beneficiary and sets releaseTime = now + 365 days.
TokenTimelock.release(): public function that checks now >= releaseTime and transfers the full token balance to the beneficiary.
TokenTimelock.setReleaseTime(uint256): onlyOwner function that extends the release time.
SafeMath.mul: checked multiplication with assert.
SafeMath.add: checked addition with assert.
SafeMath.sub: checked subtraction with assert.
SafeERC20.safeTransfer(ERC20,address,uint256): asserts token.transfer(to,value).
SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(ERC20,address,address,uint256): asserts token.transferFrom(from,to,value).
SafeERC20.safeApprove(ERC20,address,uint256): asserts token.approve(spender,value).
ERC20.balanceOf(address) view: external token balance query used in release().
ERC20.transfer(address,uint256): external token transfer callable invoked by safeTransfer.
ERC20.transferFrom(address,address,uint256): external token call invoked by safeTransferFrom.
ERC20.approve(address,uint256): external token call invoked by safeApprove.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller, used for ownership assignment and onlyOwner checks.
block.timestamp (now): miner influenceable timestamp used for the release schedule.
External call token.safeTransfer(beneficiary, amount) inside release(): interacts with an untrusted ERC20 contract.
releaseTime = now + 365 days in the constructor: timestamp-dependent state write.
External call token.transfer(to, value) inside SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
External call token.transferFrom(from, to, value) inside SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom.
External call token.approve(spender, value) inside SafeERC20.safeApprove.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership(address).
_token parameter of the TokenTimelock constructor.
_beneficiary parameter of the TokenTimelock constructor.
_releaseTime parameter of setReleaseTime(uint256).
to parameter of the SafeERC20 transfer helpers.
value parameter of the SafeERC20 transfer helpers.
from parameter of SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom.
spender parameter of SafeERC20.safeApprove.
amount local variable in release(), set from token.balanceOf(this).

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns the untrusted msg.sender to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to authorize the caller.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable during the authorization check.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setReleaseTime is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
newOwner parameter is written into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable, transferring control of the contract.
_token constructor parameter is stored in the token state variable.
_beneficiary constructor parameter is stored in the beneficiary state variable.
block.timestamp is used to compute the initial release time.
The timestamp-derived assignment writes the releaseTime state variable.
release() is gated by require(now >= releaseTime), a timestamp dependency.
releaseTime state variable is read in the require check of release().
release() executes an external token transfer via safeTransfer.
beneficiary state variable is the recipient of the external token transfer.
token state variable supplies the ERC20 contract used for the transfer in release().
release() queries the token balance through ERC20.balanceOf.
amount local variable is assigned from token.balanceOf(this).
amount local variable is passed as the value argument of the external safeTransfer call.
_releaseTime parameter is written into the releaseTime state variable.
setReleaseTime performs the owner-authorized write to releaseTime.
safeTransfer performs the external call token.transfer.
The external ERC20.transfer call can re-enter the calling contract.
to parameter is forwarded to the external token.transfer call.
value parameter is forwarded to the external token.transfer call.
safeTransferFrom performs the external call token.transferFrom.
The external ERC20.transferFrom call can re-enter the calling contract.
from parameter is forwarded to the external token.transferFrom call.
safeApprove performs the external call token.approve.
The external ERC20.approve call can re-enter the calling contract.
spender parameter is forwarded to the external token.approve call.
release() reaches the external token call through the SafeERC20 helper safeTransfer.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only used to overwrite the owner state variable inside transferOwnership.
_token is only used to initialize the token state variable in the constructor.
_beneficiary is only used to initialize the beneficiary state variable in the constructor.
_releaseTime is only used to update the releaseTime state variable in setReleaseTime.
to is only forwarded to the external token transfer call made by safeTransfer.
value is only forwarded to the external token transfer call made by safeTransfer.
from is only forwarded to the external token.transferFrom call made by safeTransferFrom.
spender is only forwarded to the external token.approve call made by safeApprove.
amount is computed in release() solely to be passed as the value of the external safeTransfer call.
